records.jp: わー、懐かしいなぁ
records.en_original: Wow, this really takes me back.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, this really takes me back.
records.en: Wow, this really takes me back.

records.jp: 懐かしい？
records.en_original: Takes you back?
records.en_auxiliary: Takes you back?
records.en: Takes you back?

records.jp: わたし、実は元演劇部なんです
records.en_original: I actually used to be in the drama club.
records.en_auxiliary: I actually used to be in the drama club.
records.en: I actually used to be in the drama club.

records.jp: マジで！？
records.en_original: Really?!
records.en_auxiliary: Really?!
records.en: Really?!

records.jp: と言っても、基本は裏方で<CR>たまに舞台に出ても脇役ばかりでしたけど
records.en_original: Well, mostly behind the scenes. Even when I was on stage, I was only in supporting roles.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, mostly behind the scenes. Even when I was on stage, I was only in supporting roles.
records.en: Though I mostly worked behind the scenes.<CR>Even when I appeared onstage, I only played supporting roles.

records.jp: どういう役やってたの？
records.en_original: What kind of roles did you play?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of roles did you play?
records.en: What kind of roles did you play?

records.jp: 村人Aとか、町娘Bとか、そんな感じですよ
records.en_original: Villager A, Town Girl B, those kinds of parts.
records.en_auxiliary: Villager A, Town Girl B, those kinds of parts.
records.en: Villager A, Town Girl B, those kinds of parts.

records.jp: あ、でもあれは割と大事な役だったかも
records.en_original: Ah, but there was one time I had a pretty important role.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, but there was one time I had a pretty important role.
records.en: Ah, but there was one time I had a pretty important role.

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: What was it?
records.en_auxiliary: What was it?
records.en: What was it?

records.jp: 主人公に毒を盛る、侍女の役です。<CR>最終的には味方になるんですけど
records.en_original: I played a maid who poisons the main character. They become friends in the end, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I played a maid who poisons the main character. They become friends in the end, though.
records.en: A maid who poisons the protagonist.<CR>She ultimately becomes an ally, though.

records.jp: （悪女を演じる詩帆さん……<CR>ちょっと見てみたいかも）
records.en_original: (I wouldn't mind seeing Shiho play the role of a villain...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I wouldn't mind seeing Shiho play the role of a villain...)
records.en: (I wouldn't mind seeing Shiho-san<CR>play the role of a villain...)

records.jp: 裏方って、どんなことしてたの？
records.en_original: What did you do behind the scenes?
records.en_auxiliary: What did you do behind the scenes?
records.en: What did you do behind the scenes?

records.jp: 小道具を作ってました。劇中で使う新聞とか、<CR>演者さんが使う武器とか
records.en_original: I made props. Like newspapers to be used onstage, or weapons used by the performers.
records.en_auxiliary: I made props. Like newspapers to be used onstage, or weapons used by the performers.
records.en: I made props. Like newspapers to be used onstage, or<CR>weapons used by the performers.

records.jp: 一見地味な役どころですけど、小道具って<CR>作品全体のリアリティやクオリティに関わるので
records.en_original: It sounds dull, but props really add a lot to the quality and realism of a performance.
records.en_auxiliary: It sounds dull, but props really add a lot to the quality and realism of a performance.
records.en: It may seem like an unglamorous role, but props affect<CR>the realism and overall quality of the entire production.

records.jp: 大変でしたけど、やりがいのある仕事でした
records.en_original: It was tough, but it was worth the effort.
records.en_auxiliary: It was tough, but it was worth the effort.
records.en: It was tough, but it was worth the effort.

records.jp: （たしかに詩帆さんに向いてる気がする。<CR>すごく丁寧に作ってくれそうだなぁ）
records.en_original: (It sounds like something Shiho would be good at. She probably puts a lot of care into her work.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It sounds like something Shiho would be good at. She probably puts a lot of care into her work.)
records.en: (It sounds like something Shiho-san would be good at.<CR>She probably puts a lot of care into her work.)

records.jp: でも憧れるなぁ。演劇って。<CR>私も一回はやってみたいかも
records.en_original: That's really cool. I've always wanted to try doing theater at least once.
records.en_auxiliary: That's really cool. I've always wanted to try doing theater at least once.
records.en: That's really cool. I've always wanted<CR>to try doing theater at least once.

records.jp: 演じてみたい役とかありますか？
records.en_original: Is there a role you've always wanted to play?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there a role you've always wanted to play?
records.en: Is there a role you've always wanted to play?

records.jp: 闇墜ちした聖騎士、かな
records.en_original: Maybe a paladin that's turned to the dark side!
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe a paladin that's turned to the dark side!
records.en: Maybe a holy knight who's fallen to darkness.

records.jp: 闇墜ちというのは、正義から悪へ<CR>墜ちたという意味ですか？
records.en_original: When you say turned to the dark side, do you mean that they were once righteous but turned evil?
records.en_auxiliary: When you say turned to the dark side, do you mean that they were once righteous but turned evil?
records.en: When you say turned to the dark side, do you mean that<CR>they were once righteous but turned evil?

records.jp: そ、そうだよ
records.en_original: Y-yeah, exactly.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah, exactly.
records.en: Y-yeah, exactly.

records.jp: 聖騎士は普通の騎士とはどう違うのでしょうか
records.en_original: How is a paladin different from a regular knight, anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: How is a paladin different from a regular knight, anyway?
records.en: How is a paladin different from a regular knight, anyway?

records.jp: えっとね、聖騎士は神の加護を受けていてね
records.en_original: Well, um, paladins are holy knights who have been given God's blessing.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, um, paladins are holy knights who have been given God's blessing.
records.en: Well, um, paladins are holy knights who have been given God's blessing.

records.jp: へー、加護ってどうやって受けるんですか？
records.en_original: Oh, really? How do they get God's blessing?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, really? How do they get God's blessing?
records.en: Oh, really? How do they get God's blessing?

records.jp: ……ごめん、やっぱなんでもない。<CR>普通に騎士でいいや
records.en_original: ...Never mind, it was a silly idea. I'll just be a regular knight.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Never mind, it was a silly idea. I'll just be a regular knight.
records.en: ...Never mind, it was a silly idea. I'll<CR>just be a regular knight.

records.jp: ？　そうですか
records.en_original: Oh, okay...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, okay...
records.en: Oh, okay...

records.jp: 妖艶な魔女、とか
records.en_original: Maybe a seductive witch?
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe a seductive witch?
records.en: Maybe a seductive witch?

records.jp: え、な、なんでですか？
records.en_original: Wha... Um... Wh-why?
records.en_auxiliary: Wha... Um... Wh-why?
records.en: Wha... Um... Wh-why?

records.jp: せっかく他人になりきるなら、<CR>自分と正反対の役の方が面白くない？
records.en_original: If you get to become someone else, wouldn't it be more fun to be someone who's your polar opposite of you?
records.en_auxiliary: If you get to become someone else, wouldn't it be more fun to be someone who's your polar opposite of you?
records.en: If you're going to become someone else anyway,<CR>wouldn't it be more fun to play your exact opposite?

records.jp: それは……確かにそうかもしれません
records.en_original: Ah, I guess that's true...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I guess that's true...
records.en: Ah, I guess that's true...

records.jp: 普段の自分なら言わないこと、言えないことを<CR>言えるのが、お芝居の醍醐味ですからね
records.en_original: The best part of acting is being able to say things you normally wouldn't.
records.en_auxiliary: The best part of acting is being able to say things you normally wouldn't.
records.en: The best part of acting is being able to say things<CR>you normally wouldn't or couldn't say.

records.jp: （詩帆さんみたいな真面目な人も……<CR>いや、真面目な人だからこそ感じるのかな）
records.en_original: (Even for someone as serious as Shiho... No, especially for someone like her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Even for someone as serious as Shiho... No, especially for someone like her.)
records.en: (Even for someone as serious as Shiho-san...<CR>No, especially for someone like her.)

records.jp: まぁ、今から演劇部は無理でも、<CR>学祭で出し物するとかならやってみたいかも
records.en_original: Well, even if we can't join the drama club now, I'd like to try performing at a school festival sometime.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, even if we can't join the drama club now, I'd like to try performing at a culture festival sometime.
records.en: Well, even if we can't join the drama club now,<CR>I'd like to try performing at a school festival sometime.

records.jp: 歌ったりする方もいますよね。あれも楽しそうです
records.en_original: Yeah! Some people sing at those too. I've always thought that looked like a lot of fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Some people sing at those too. I've always thought that looked like a lot of fun.
records.en: Yeah! Some people sing at those too. I've always thought that looked like a lot of fun.

records.jp: 詩帆さんってそういうのも向いてるかもね
records.en_original: You might be good at that, Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: You might be good at that, Shiho.
records.en: You might be good at that, Shiho-san.

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: かわいいし、声も綺麗だし。<CR>演劇部仕込みの度胸もあるし
records.en_original: You're cute and you have a nice voice. Plus you have the guts of a drama club member!
records.en_auxiliary: You're cute and you have a nice voice. Plus you have the guts of a drama club member!
records.en: You're cute and have a beautiful voice.<CR>And you've got the courage you built up in drama club.

records.jp: そんな……
records.en_original: I'm not sure about that...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure about that...
records.en: I'm not sure about that...

records.jp: ちょっとさ、ステージの前の方立って<CR>やってみてよ。シミュレーション
records.en_original: Here, stand at the front of the stage. Let's do a trial run!
records.en_auxiliary: Here, stand at the front of the stage. Let's do a trial run!
records.en: Here, stand at the front of the<CR>stage. Let's do a trial run!

records.jp: ええ～……
records.en_original: What...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...?
records.en: What...?

records.jp: みなさーん、<CR>今日は来てくれてありがとうございます！
records.en_original: Thank you all for coming today!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you all for coming today!
records.en: Everyooone!<CR>Thank you for coming today!

records.jp: 最後まで楽しんでいってくださいね☆
records.en_original: Please enjoy the rest of the show!
records.en_auxiliary: Please enjoy the rest of the show!
records.en: Please enjoy yourselves all the way to the end☆

records.jp: めっちゃいい！
records.en_original: That was great!
records.en_auxiliary: That was great!
records.en: That was great!

records.jp: 今からでも遅くないよ、詩帆さん。<CR>芸能界デビューしよう！
records.en_original: It's not too late, Shiho! You can still make your show biz debut!
records.en_auxiliary: It's not too late, Shiho! You can still make your show biz debut!
records.en: It's not too late, Shiho-san! You can still<CR>make your show biz debut!

records.jp: 何言ってるんですか、もう！<CR>興味ないですから！
records.en_original: Wh-what are you talking about?! I don't want to do that!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you talking about?! I don't want to do that!
records.en: Wh-what are you talking about?! I<CR>don't want to do that!

records.jp: アイドルなんだ。<CR>私何も指定してなかったんだけど
records.en_original: You're a natural star! I didn't give you any directions or anything!
records.en_auxiliary: You're a natural star! I didn't give you any directions or anything!
records.en: So you chose an idol.<CR>I didn't specify anything at all.

records.jp: え、いや、イメージでなんとなくそうしただけで！
records.en_original: Oh, but...I just said whatever came to mind!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, but...I just said whatever came to mind!
records.en: Oh, but...I just said whatever came to mind!

records.jp: 詩帆さんの秘めたるアイドル願望が……
records.en_original: I never knew your secret dream was to become a pop star...
records.en_auxiliary: I never knew your secret dream was to become a pop star...
records.en: Your secret desire to become an idol is showing, Shiho-san...

records.jp: ありませんから！
records.en_original: I don't!
records.en_auxiliary: I don't!
records.en: I don't!

records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
